_readme: Dormant. The vinyl shelf on cool.html renders only if 'tracks' has entries. Spotify does not expose a recently-played list to a static page, so any albums here have to be added by hand (with square cover art in assets/img/music/). Left empty on purpose: the live 'now playing' card is the music feature.
heading: On repeat
blurb: Click a sleeve to pull the record out.
